properties.value: Triple DES (3DES) is deprecated due to its small block size (64 bits) which makes it vulnerable to birthday attacks and other cryptographic weaknesses. It should be replaced with AES.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Single DES is deprecated due to its vulnerability to brute-force attacks. The 56-bit key size makes it susceptible to modern computing power.

properties.value: Static initialization vectors or nonces are a serious security issue as they can lead to pattern recognition and weaken the encryption. Each encryption operation should use a unique IV/nonce.

properties.value: ML-DSA (Dilithium) is a post-quantum digital signature algorithm that's part of the NIST PQC standard. It provides security against quantum computing attacks.

properties.value: ML-KEM (Kyber) is a post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism that's part of the NIST PQC standard. It provides security against quantum computing attacks.
